mintAuthority.summary: Replacement USDv is minted by the Chancery program PDA through permissioned collateral settlement. Live governance and operational Squads quorums permit one signature, while economic widening remains subject to separate program delays. Program upgrades require three of seven vote-capable members (eight total members) and a two-day Squads delay. Whole-program economic mint bounds remain unresolved.

review.evidence: Current finalized on-chain mint/config/ProgramData and seven Squads accounts establish the new mint PDA, separate control roles and upgrade path. All seven vault derivations reproduce the declared addresses. Live governance, operations, treasury, enforcement and insurance thresholds differ from the September 4 issuer disclosure, so live values replace those historical claims. Source-level direct settlement checks collateral received, configurable rates and per-transaction limits; one-signature role quorums do not bypass program risk-class pending-change delays. We have not enumerated every live permission, pathway, migration or reserve-outflow policy, so no immutable cap, universally collateral-gated mint posture, continuous financial reconciliation, prudential supervision or new-token insurance coverage is claimed. The old mint, old program, legacy 3-of-9 authority and Ceffu reserve model are excluded.
